nodes.long_description:
1. place the elemental powders of barium (Ba), calcium (Ca), copper (Cu), potassium (K), lithium (Li), sodium (Na), and strontium (Sr) on the table
2. place 7 ceramic bowls for the elements on the table
3. place the alcohol swabs on the porcelain bowls
4. place the elemental powders of barium (Ba), calcium (Ca), copper (Cu), potassium (K), lithium (Li), sodium (Na), and strontium (Sr) in the ceramic bowls
5. light the igniter to ignite the elements and observe the color of the flame for each element
6. place the strontium (Sr) on the firecracker launcher and ignite it
7. Observe the color of the firecrackers

<Results
Learn the different flame colors of the elements.
nodes.short_description: Dive into the colorful world of flame tests. This experiment involves burning different elements to observe the color of their flames, teaching about the electromagnetic spectrum and electron energy levels.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic chemistry experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual chemical reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine chemical changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
